Reassessed negative confidence under the revised rule using saved research. No retained English query. No new search or full recheck.
Attempted preservation of cited source copies and checked saved-copy hashes; failures remain in source access notes. This source-evidence work is not a full factual recheck of the record.

English searches for a national AI safety, security or evaluation institute, commitment, proposal or study. The English query did not identify a qualifying institute, commitment, proposal or institute-specific study. The reviewed law defines an advisory Hungarian AI Council and AI Act governance. Research funding and national AI development programmes do not by themselves establish an evaluator. Partial check only; the last full-check date is unchanged.
Read the AI market surveillance authority's About page: it operates as a unit of the Ministry of Science and Technology. Partial check; the last full-check date is unchanged.

Corrected the notes against section 4(1) of Act LXXV of 2025: the instruments designate the AI Act authorities, and the notifying authority designates conformity assessment bodies on the basis of their accreditation. Bound the AI Council's first meeting on 15 December 2025 to the council's concluding declaration. Wording correction only; the last full-check date is unchanged.

News search from 17 October 2026 in English and Hungarian, with the science and technology ministry's page (newest 28 October). Added press reports (Agence Europe, 23 October; MLex, 3 November) of Hungary's proposal for an EU Frontier AI Safety and Security Team; the non-paper itself was not found. The ministry's news listing could not be read, and no Hungarian national-body commitment or new domestic AI Act designation was found. Partial check, not a full record re-check.

check.language_note: The recorded hu query uses a national or official language selected for this country-specific check. Other national or official languages were not exhaustively searched. Search source_ids identify registered source URLs matched in the retrieved result set, which may include irrelevant hits. An empty list means no registered source URL was matched, not that the web response was empty. The earlier audit used independent_source_ids for substantive corroboration; governance_source_ids, where present, identifies the selected primary governance evidence. English queries were also run on 17 October 2026; the previously recorded national or official-language coverage and its limits are unchanged.
check.independence_note: Historical audit under the superseded two-independent-sources rule: Two substantively independent evidence origins were not established. Multiple pages from one owner, mirrors, reports of the same underlying announcement and general regional coverage are not counted as independent corroboration.
check.governance_note: The AI Act implementation law sets supervisory arrangements and an advisory AI Council without decision-making powers. Later decree amendments were not fully read.

claims.text: Act LXXV of 2025 tasks it with supporting the national AI strategy and policy through proposals to the government.

record.summary: No qualifying institute identified as of October 2026. Minister of Science and Technology (minister responsible for enterprise development in AI matters) is its AI Act single point of contact and market-surveillance authority; one other AI Act body is listed below.
record.notes:
Checked in full on or before 16 October 2026, searching in Hungarian and English.

Next check due by 31 March 2027.
